Projects whose toolchain has no plugin API (Angular CLI, plain webpack, custom servers) get the HTML `page` artifact. My notes list this among the earlier owner decisions that still stand, alongside Option C for live components, pins applied by the agent, and real code from the first screen.

Slice 1 covers the sheet artifact, which uses the `cawcoStage()` Vite plugin and `/@cawco/sheet`. That plugin path is Vite-only, so the `page` artifact is the route for everything else.

My summary doesn't keep the discussion that led to the decision, the exact wording, or the date. I can't say what alternatives were weighed or what the owner said. I also have no memory of whether a Vite 5 question, which is still open for sheets, affects this.
